narrative:
The impairment charge is £7.3M in the FY2026 budget — a cost of risk of about 15 bps. The 9+3 forecast is £14.5M (about 30 bps) after four development finance schemes in the South East & East (£52M) moved to stage 2 in Q3.

FY2025 was benign: the Group charge fell to £6.5M (0.2% cost of risk) and Bank ECL provisions were £21.5M with 0.5% coverage. Specialist mortgages, bridging and wholesale finance are on plan; development finance carries almost all of the variance.
